categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of RFID electronic tags and related hardware and software systems. It functions as a holding company with subsidiaries engaged in RFID inlay production, antenna and reader module design, system integration, and after-sales services. The main product line is RFID electronic tags, including high-frequency and ultra-high-frequency tags, serving various industries such as retail, logistics, industrial manufacturing, and healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced RFID technologies including flip chip manufacturing processes for RFID inlays. It integrates IC design, communication technology, and material science to develop products with enhanced activation frequency, read/write speed, distance, and reliability. The firm also focuses on antenna design, packaging technologies, and has developed specialized tags such as high-temperature resistant embedded tire tags and washable soft textile tags. It maintains an EPC Global standard laboratory for product testing and employs automation to improve production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global retail brands such as Uniqlo, Walmart, Decathlon, and Unilever, as well as clients in logistics, industrial manufacturing, and healthcare sectors. The company’s RFID tags are widely used for apparel labeling, retail product management, and supply chain tracking. Major end markets are in Asia (notably China, Vietnam, Japan), Europe, and the Americas, with a strong focus on fast fashion and retail industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Asia, with major production bases in Taipei, Taiwan, and Yangzhou, China. It also has subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong and Japan to support sales and customer service. The majority of sales revenue comes from Asian markets, followed by Europe and the Americas. The company is expanding its global supply chain and delivery capabilities to serve international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream segment of the RFID supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of RFID electronic tags and components. It sources raw materials such as chips and antennas from upstream suppliers and sells finished RFID tags directly to downstream customers including brand owners and system integrators. It also provides after-sales services and system integration support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to develop customized RFID tags tailored to diverse application scenarios, enhancing product performance and expanding product lines such as visual LED tags and medical packaging RFID tags. The company emphasizes automation to address global labor shortages and improve production efficiency. It is also investing in software and system development to enable intelligent manufacturing, quality inspection, and sales analytics, while pursuing sustainability through environmental-friendly materials and ESG initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of RFID electronic tags and related hardware products. The company also derives income from software system development, RFID reader devices, and after-sales services. It operates on a direct sales model to brand customers and system integrators, with a focus on large-volume orders and long-term contracts. Capital raising through equity issuance supports operational expansion and R&D.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading RFID electronic tag manufacturer in Asia and holds a significant global market share estimated at around 13-14% in key markets. It competes with other RFID tag producers and RFID solution providers, differentiating itself through advanced R&D capabilities, product quality certifications such as ARC quality certification, and strong relationships with major international brands. Its scale and technological leadership provide competitive advantages in a fragmented market dominated by smaller players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.1 billion in 2022, with a net profit after tax of NT$338 million and earnings per share of NT$5.18. It has shown steady revenue growth and profitability improvements over recent years. The company completed a successful IPO on the Taiwan Stock Exchange in March 2023, enhancing its capital structure and supporting future growth. Total assets were around NT$4.5 billion with equity of about NT$4 billion as of 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D and product development capabilities, enabling it to offer highly customized RFID tags that meet diverse customer needs across industries. It holds unique certifications such as the ARC quality certification, positioning it as a trusted supplier for demanding retail and industrial clients. Its advanced manufacturing processes, high product quality, and integrated solutions including software and cloud services differentiate it from competitors. The company also focuses on sustainability and ESG compliance, appealing to environmentally conscious customers.
